Quantity Decrease quantity for HANAMI Germanium Fuzz Increase quantity for HANAMI Germanium Fuzz Add to cart     Description HANAMI is a fuzz we feel is a natural successor sonically from where the BONEYARD left off. Rather than seeking to emulate anyone else’s circuits, HANAMI sits perfectly between the BONEYARD and the FALLOUT CLOUD. It is a fuzz that takes inspiration from the past but offers modern features and a sonic footprint that is inspirational no matter what styles of music you play. Built with 4x NOS Mil Spec germanium transistors and 1x NOS Germanium Diode. HANAMI is loaded with saturation offering smooth, rewarding and evolutionary fuzz tones from one easy to navigate control set.
